name: XDKNet 3.0.3.2
body:
XDKNet 3.0.3.2 fixes moving through a show's episodes with the remote.
Update the server plugin to 3.0.3.2 along with the app.

## Fixed

- On a show, season or episode page, moving down through the episodes now
  scrolls the page with you, so the highlighted episode stays on screen,
  and moving back up brings the tabs back into view. Before, the highlight
  went off the bottom of the screen and you had to press up blindly.
- On an episode's page, moving down from the tabs to that episode in the
  list scrolls it into view.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
